Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Edward de Vere’s paternal grandfather was John de Vere, 14th Earl of Oxford. This reflects a misinterpretation of ordinal succession and familial relationships—the father of John de Vere, 16th Earl of Oxford, is John de Vere, 15th Earl of Oxford, not the 14th. The Planner failed to verify this by opening and checking the John de Vere, 16th Earl of Oxford page, and prematurely marked the task complete based on an incorrect assumption and irrelevant “related links” rather than explicit citations.
